headline: PROP sector dominates with KC soaring +50.00% and PF plunging -20.00% amid recent capital‑change filings.
market_take: Today's coverage shows sharp divergence in the PROP sector, led by KC's +50.00% jump and PF's -20.00% slide. FOOD stocks posted notable intraday spikes, especially XBIO (+16.67%) and CHOTI's -100.00% open gap. PF&REIT and CONMAT experienced several price‑gap and volume‑spike alerts, while a cluster of filings across sectors points to corporate actions and potential risk.

XBIO recorded a +16.67% intraday rise and filed a capital‑change on 31‑Aug. CHOTI opened with a -100.00% gap; TWPC announced an acquisition, and PRG disclosed a dividend and a connected‑transaction lease.
PLE posted a +16.67% intraday move and triggered an unusual‑trading alert; TPOLY filed a high‑priority business‑rehabilitation petition on 31‑Aug and showed a +11.11% open‑gap.
LUXF fell -6.19% with a -7.62% open gap; TNPF and MNRF saw extreme volume spikes (27.1σ and 23.4σ). WHART filed a capital‑change notice for a trust‑unit offering.
PPPM experienced a -6.90% open‑gap, flagging potential downside pressure.
